title: Soul Snack #16: Experiences of Multisensory Perception
excerpt: Today, Gary, in conversation with Linda, explores the profound transformation of human consciousness and the concept of multi-sensory perception.
bodyHtml:
Today, Gary, in conversation with Linda, explores the profound transformation of human consciousness and the concept of multi-sensory perception.

They share personal stories that illustrate the power of intuition and connection, emphasizing the importance of recognizing and embracing these experiences in our lives and culminating in a reflection on the unique connection with a child named Sarah Rose, highlighting the lessons learned about awareness and perception beyond the five senses.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Snack:

  • (00:41): How intuition often reveals deeper truths about ourselves and others
  • (03:08): How Linda experienced multisensory perception when meeting Gary
  • (04:52): The story of Sarah Rose illustrates the power of connection beyond senses
  • (08:01): Experiencing awareness beyond the Earth School

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge: Reflect on a time when you experienced multisensory perception (perhaps a hunch or synchronicity). Journal about these experiences and open yourself to receiving more from your intuition.
